subject: AI4Kanban — Decide it, then watch it get built
preheader: Work out what to build before you write the card, follow every agent at work, and start a project from the launcher.
headline: Decide it, then watch it get built.
intro: Here are a few highlights from our recent updates. Explore the full release notes for everything we’ve shipped.

highlights.label: DISCUSS
highlights.title: Talk it through before it is a card
highlights.body: When you cannot yet say what you want, Discuss is where you work it out. Talk the idea over until there is something worth doing, then turn it into a card — which is where the details get settled.

image.alt: The Discuss screen: a rough idea typed in, the agent asking which half of onboarding it is, and Discuss picked beside Add task and Build now.

highlights.label: RUNS
highlights.title: See every agent at work
highlights.body: Every running task in one place: the Runs office shows each agent with the role it is playing, the coding agent behind it and the card it is on. How all the parallel work stands, in a glance.

image.alt: The Runs office: six agents at labelled desks with their card numbers, two finished agents on the sofa, and 6 running along the bottom.

highlights.label: DELIVERY
highlights.title: Deliveries retry themselves
highlights.body: When the target branch moves under a delivery, it starts over on the new code by itself instead of stopping for you. And notifications now separate what is waiting on your answer from what already landed.

image.alt: The Notifications rail: Question waiting on the newest card, Landed on the two below it.

highlights.label: PROJECTS
highlights.title: Start a project from the launcher
highlights.body: Name a new project, pick where it goes, and the launcher makes the folder and its Git repository for you, then opens setup. Nothing to prepare first — an empty repository is a fine place to start.

image.alt: The launcher's new-project form: a project name, the folder it goes in, Cancel and Create.
